signal_reinterpretation.interpretation: Quantization functions are NOT mild: quantization_median maps each channel to 20/15/10/6/3 levels and quantization_hist to 24/16/8/6/4 levels at severities 1-5, so any quantization step would cap unique values near <=24. The target keeps 214+ levels, so quantization is excluded analytically without spending a test.

Step-4 thresholds are conservative (variance_ratio<0.55, spread<0.80), so the boundary was re-examined with the actual severity tables: the mildest contrast_weaken_scale:1 (scale 0.75) implies variance_ratio ~0.56, and contrast_weaken_stretch is stronger than that; neither can produce 0.868. Brightness shift sev1 = 0.1*255 = 25.5 levels vs observed mean_shift=-0.5; saturation_weaken sev1 = 0.6-0.7 chroma scale vs observed 0.9657. NO_GLOBAL confirmed as a real finding, not a threshold miss.

Block-boundary is the 0%-FP JPEG signal. JPEG q=25 is already the mildest available severity and R0's glass2+jpeg1/2 sims lowered PSNR 34.67->32.10/31.29 and raised bb by >0.2. Pure-JPEG is excluded; no test spent.
Motion blur is excluded by the calibrated threshold (94% recall, 0% FP). Motion is also angle-random, so a single draw cannot confirm it. Not tested.

signal_reinterpretation.interpretation: R0's NO_NOISE argument ('minimum sev1 noise sigma in x_distortion is 12.75, far above peeled residual sigma 2-3, so no noise step can exist') is invalid in principle when noise precedes blur: blind_challenge forces noise priority 0 before blur priority 1, and glass's internal gaussians (sigma 0.7-1.6, applied twice) can attenuate sigma 12.75 to order ~2-4 levels, which is exactly the scale of the peeled residual (std 4.7). However there is no positive noise evidence: the peeled residual is highly structured (spatial_corr=0.95), driven by shuffle/kernel mismatch rather than white noise. Noise type under noise->blur is documented as unidentifiable (SKILL §B 54.7% ≈ random). Since R0 blur_glass:2 verify_signals is already MATCH, a noise candidate can only add structured-residual/FWHM mismatches and cannot satisfy the required WEAK->PARTIAL/MATCH improvement on the single pair.
